description: The evaluation forward pass built an unnecessary autograd graph.

notes: The training batch size is 1 (hardcoded), while evaluation uses batch=16. The peak memory (2.43 GB allocated) occurs during evaluation forward pass with autograd enabled. Fixing the evaluation to use torch.no_grad() eliminates the autograd graph for validation, reducing peak allocated memory from ~2.4 GB to ~0.4 GB (training peak), saving ~2 GB which exceeds the required 0.487 GB. The model parameters (0.15 GB) and optimizer state (SGD, no persistent state) are unaffected.
The save estimate is conservative; actual saving may be closer to 2 GB. Training loss and update semantics are unchanged. No policy permissions required.
